  "hypotheses": [
    {
      "explanation":"new_customer",
      "likelihood":"medium",
      "reasoning":"A newly opened account may be retrying checkout after payment difficulties. Successful AVS and CVV and the absence of account linkage support this benign possibility."
    },
    {
      "explanation":"stolen_card",
      "likelihood":"medium",
      "reasoning":"Repeated device-level processor declines alongside elevated account attempts could reflect card testing. Successful AVS and CVV mean the country mismatch does not independently establish the Card geography rule."
    }
  ],
  "disposition":"needs_check",
  "citations":["FP-2 §6.6(b)","R07","R05","FP-2 §5.2","FP-2 §5.3(a)","FP-2 §4.3","FP-2 §6.3","FP-2 §6.4","FP-2 §8.1"],
  "next_check":"id_check",
  "memo":"R07 establishes Card from three device processor declines; R05 establishes Velocity from five account attempts. No other rule holds, no household exception applies, and no earlier outcome settles the order. The country mismatch does not trigger R03 because neither AVS nor CVV failed. Repeated checkout difficulties by a new customer remain plausible alongside card testing. With no completed checks, §6.6(b) permits decline, but verification offers a less restrictive resolution. Recommend needs_check, implemented as a hold with id_check before shipment. This single check covers both present families; a pass requires clear, while failure requires decline without Linkage. No installments were due, so non-payment cannot support this recommendation."
